chunks: And from him, from ʿAlī, from his father, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz, from Zurārah, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام, who said:
When you are behind an Imam whom you follow, then remain silent and recite tasbih within yourself.

key_terms.إِمَامٍ: the prayer leader being followed in congregational salat
key_terms.تَأْتَمُّ: you follow in prayer as a ma'mum behind the Imam
key_terms.فَأَنْصِتْ: remain silent and listen without reciting aloud

ai.seo_question: What should a person do when praying behind an Imam in congregational salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction for one praying behind an Imam in congregational salat. It directs the follower to remain silent and engage in tasbih inwardly rather than reciting aloud.
